confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on crowd-sourced Numbeo medians (its Tulum page, dated around October 2026) and secondary blog figures, not official July 2026 surveys. Pesos were converted at an assumed rate of about 17.5 MXN per USD, which I did not verify by search. Cocktail and wine_glass are not directly sourced: they are set at roughly 2.5 times the draft-beer anchor, and Numbeo's Tulum bottle-of-wine figure looks low for restaurant pricing. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from inspected listings or searches. Beach-club and resort prices run well above these medians. The FX observation (16 October 2026) comes from search-result text quoting the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page or the F11 file.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Tulum-specific Numbeo medians, cross-checked against Numbeo's Tulum comparisons with Playa del Carmen (Tulum about 6% cheaper) and Cancún (about 16% more expensive). Accommodation is a holistic estimate benchmarked against Playa del Carmen-type Riviera Maya beach-town pricing.
